market.summary: GIFT Nifty points to a higher open after Monday's 1.68% Nifty rise, helped by a much bigger crude fall than last evening showed: Brent ended near $105, down over 7%. Against that, tech sold off overnight, Korea is down about 3% this morning, and US midterm voting today adds event risk. The NIFTY 500 closed 2 Nov still under its 50 and 200 DMA, so the screener's RISK-OFF size-down message stands even if the open is strong.

points.text: GIFT Nifty about 23,525 at 8:36 IST, up about 123 points (+0.53%) on its previous level; Nifty closed 2 Nov at 23,440.80.
US close 2 Nov: Dow +0.41% to 51,983.98, S&P 500 -0.51% to 7,541.40, Nasdaq -1.07% to 25,164.32, on worries over AI spending; Marvell -12.7% on its Lumentum deal. Jobs report is due 6 Nov.
Asia this morning: Korea down over 3% (fell as much as 3.8%), Taiwan -1.3%, Hong Kong +0.3%; Japan closed for a holiday.
Brent about $104.7, steady after falling more than 7% on Monday on Iran-Qatar talks; a reported US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island adds uncertainty.
FIIs bought Rs 3,114.68 Cr and DIIs sold Rs 392.20 Cr in cash on 2 Nov (provisional), the FIIs' second buying day in a row; USD/INR about 94.89.
NIFTY 500 22,241 on 2 Nov vs 50 DMA 22,542 and 200 DMA 22,769; only 28% of tracked stocks are above their 21-day EMA.

market.watch: US midterm results (Wed morning India time onward), Hormuz headlines, and the NIFTY 500 against its 50 DMA near 22,540.
